description: Switches how requests the user types in the Moontide page reach you. State on returns the command to run now with your Monitor tool, so each request arrives as soon as it is sent. State off says how to stop that monitor, after which requests wait on the Moontide server and arrive in the reply of your next other Moontide tool. Call it when the user asks, in any words, to turn page requests on or off, to take requests from the Moontide page right away, or to stop. The page-requests-on and page-requests-off prompts do the same where the client offers MCP prompts.

state.description: on to receive each page request right away, off to let them wait for the reply of your next other Moontide tool

name: set_page_requests
